g.text: Cold admission of the appointed retention object
recovery classifies domains, admission parses; the reader counts before it enumerates and authenticates M beside R
Authenticate each checkpoint object's length and digest,
and classify its domain prefix under the reader capability
(a V1-only reader refuses RetA and RetR: UnknownObjectDomain)
Parse the checkpoint descriptor by its domain: Chkp1 under the
V1 rule; Chkp2 under the V2 rule, for a dual reader only
(anchor of 136 bytes; DATA minus R at least 2 objects and 186 bytes)
Load the appointed retention object through the bounded store
before any radix node is read
Current entry equals the catalog's state?
Phase one: read each reachable radix node once, check
its shape at the key width still unread, and count leaf
occurrences with a memo keyed by (digest, width)
Phase two: reserve exactly n entries and enumerate
them from the nodes already read (EntryAllocation
Require strictly increasing entries, none equal
M is the anchor plus every node read, in digest order
M is the manifest: one object of its own length
At a checkpoint terminal, require DATA minus R
to equal M in objects and in bytes
Walk the current closure, then each historical state
(its generation below the current one), and compare
the retained union with the descriptor
Report, with the metadata objects and bytes
